description: Sons Mgmt is a Los Angeles–based artist management company founded by Jesse Giddings.
about: Sons Mgmt is an artist management company based in Los Angeles.

Founded by Jesse Giddings — longtime television host at MuchMusic and E! News — Sons was built on a simple idea: artists deserve managers who understand cameras, press, and audiences firsthand. Jesse spent a decade interviewing the biggest artists in the world; now he works on their side of the table.
The name comes from family. Two sons, two brothers — it was always Giddings & Sons. We kept it simple.
